/* Block comment */
class Greeter
  (@name = 'world') ->

  greet: (times = 1) ->
    text = "Hello, #{@name}! Count: #{times}\n"
    [text for i from 1 to times].join ''

greeter = new Greeter 'live'
console.log greeter.greet 2
